cites.text: Dmitri came back to me yesterday. Finance went through the processor statement, and the EU failure rate hasn't moved, it's 19 percent again in the second week. So that puts the trial question back on the table today, properly, it's open.

cites.text: Okay. I'm going to decide. We switch to a seven day trial, credit card required up front.

text: In meeting 2, Meera stated that due to time constraints and data issues, the trial policy was changed to a 30-day trial with a card required at signup.

cites.speaker: Meera
cites.text: Okay. I've got 25 days to launch, a page that has to be final, and a week of numbers that don't support what we picked. We're switching Insights to the 30-day trial with a card required at signup.

text: Sofia explained that this decision was based on last year's low attendance despite high travel subsidies.

cites.speaker: Sofia
cites.text: Because look at last year. We put 180,000 dollars into customer travel subsidies and only 34 percent of target accounts actually turned up. Whereas with those three cities most of them are a short trip away, a train or a quick hop, not a whole week gone out of the office.

text: Meera resolved that the trial policy would revert to a 14-day free trial with no card required.

cites.text: Right. 19 percent failing that we can't touch before January, 30 cents an account, twelve days. Insights goes back to the 14-day free trial with no card required.

cites.text: Fine. Done.

cites.text: Nothing's changed today. It's still the three roadshows until somebody shows me otherwise. But I've heard you, Ingrid.
